shared_elements: incised/outlined linear rendering without interior modelling
justification: Both surfaces present a schematic, outline-drawn humanoid presence accompanied by simple curved and circular signs, but that is a very generic correspondence: A shows a full striding figure in profile-ish action with splayed hands, an oversized head/legs and small quadruped and hook-like signs scattered around it, while B is a frontal, blocky torso-and-head form whose surface carries an arrangement of paired arcs, a central ring and belt-like bands as applied ornament rather than a narrative scene. The relationships differ fundamentally — A juxtaposes separate figures and signs across an open field, whereas B nests symmetrical motifs onto a single body — so no shared iconographic scheme is evident.
